title: Fingerprint cache and amortization qualification
question: Can auto-generated hydraulic representations be reused safely across columns through a deterministic immutable cache so that construction cost is paid once per unique hydraulic authority/policy key?

key_fields: authoritative hydraulic coefficient vector required by the builder
key_contract.hit_validation: full exact key comparison is mandatory; fingerprint equality alone is insufficient

cache_contract.same_key: must return the same cached representation without rebuilding
cache_contract.capacity: bounded research cache with explicit failure when full; no silent eviction in this qualification

requirements: all repeated identical requests are hits
cached support arrays remain byte-identical across hits
reported build and lookup costs are measured separately
